label: late-episode low-value (D1/D2 of trials 90-99)
explanation: Fires only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (97% of activation mass at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 70), at D1 and D2 but essentially never at GO, and only when the model value-head output is low (98% of mass at value < 5.2). Within that window it is strongest at D2 (68% of mass), especially after runs of unrewarded trials on the bad option (e.g. repeated a1 -> S1 unrewarded while S2 is good) and with in_state S1, and grows toward the end of the episode. ep_trial >= 90 alone gives recall 0.96 but precision 0.10; adding value < 4 raises precision to ~0.26 at recall 0.84 (mass recall 0.89). It does not fire on GO steps, early or mid episode, or high-value steps; within the late, low-value regime which steps fire is only partly captured (prev_reward==0 helps little). All variables used are observed (value is the model own output).
